description: A comprehensive roadmap to master Machine Learning, from mathematical foundations to advanced deep learning architectures.

nodes.title: Mathematics for ML
nodes.description: Essential mathematics required for machine learning, focusing on Linear Algebra, Calculus, and Probability.

project.title: Math Fundamentals Implementation
project.description: Implement basic matrix operations and gradient descent from scratch using numpy.

nodes.title: Python for Data Science
nodes.description: Mastering the Python data stack: Numpy, Pandas, and Matplotlib.

project.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
project.description: Perform EDA on a real-world dataset (e.g. Titanic or House Prices) using Pandas and Matplotlib.

nodes.title: Supervised Learning
nodes.description: Learn the core algorithms: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, and SVMs.

project.title: Predictive Modeling
project.description: Build a pipeline to clean data, train multiple supervised models, and tune hyperparameters using GridSearchCV.

nodes.title: Unsupervised Learning
nodes.description: Discovering hidden structures in data with K-Means clustering, PCA, and Anomaly Detection.

project.title: Customer Segmentation
project.description: Use K-Means and PCA to group customers based on purchasing behavior.

nodes.title: Deep Learning Fundamentals
nodes.description: Introduction to Neural Networks, Backpropagation, and frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

project.title: Image Classifier
project.description: Build and train a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) on the MNIST dataset.

nodes.title: Computer Vision (CNNs)
nodes.description: Mastering Convolutional Neural Networks for image classification, object detection, and segmentation.

project.title: Custom Object Detection
project.description: Fine-tune a pre-trained ResNet model to classify real-world images.

nodes.title: Natural Language Processing
nodes.description: Handling text data using Embeddings, RNNs, LSTMs, and modern Transformer architectures.

project.title: Sentiment Analysis App
project.description: Train a Transformer model to classify sentiment and deploy it as an API.
